name: Cookbook · SMA crossover
description: Long when SMA(short) > SMA(long). Classic trend-following starter.

name: Cookbook · RSI mean reversion
description: Buy when RSI(14) drops below 30; sell when it rises above 70.

name: Cookbook · MACD signal
description: Long when MACD line is above its signal line (12/26/9 default).

name: Cookbook · 12-1 momentum
description: Long when the trailing 12-month return (skipping the last month) is positive.

name: Cookbook · Bollinger breakout
description: Long when close breaks above the upper Bollinger band; flat below the middle.

name: Cookbook · Donchian channel
description: Long on a 20-bar high, exit on a 10-bar low. Classic CTA breakout.
